flows.title: Create a scenario and add its first app
steps: From the main dashboard, click + Create a new scenario in the top-right corner to open the Scenario Builder.
In the top-left corner, click New scenario to update your scenario's name.
Enter a name for the scenario, then click the Save icon on the Scenario Builder toolbar.
Click the giant plus in the center of the canvas to open the list of apps.
Choose the app you want to start the scenario with, then choose its trigger module.

flows.title: Set how often a scenario runs
steps: In the Scenario Builder toolbar, click Every 15 minutes to open the schedule settings.
In the Schedule setting window that appears, set how frequently your scenario should run.
Consider how frequently you need to check for new data, because a shorter interval uses more credits.
After you schedule your scenario, you are prompted to activate it. Click Activate scenario.
